title: Shooting Variation 5 - Double Pass - Give & Go - Shot

source.file: archive/sample-april-20-23/Shooting Variation 5 - Double Pass - Give ^0 Go - Shot.pdf
source.originalFilename: Shooting Variation 5 - Double Pass - Give ^0 Go - Shot.pdf

setup: 2 large goals 30 yards apart. Two lines of players, A and D, each with a ball. Two poles (=defenders) B and D, with a target player facing A and D. Goalkeepers C and F.
instructions: A passes to B, B returns the pass to A and opens up to the outside.
A dribbles toward the pole, and does a give & go with B.
B lays it off in the central space, and A shoots.
D, E and F do the same on their side.
The pole marks the offside line - players must be onside when the pass is made to them.
Rotation: A to B to C to A. D to E to F to D.
coachingPoints: Use correct dribbling and passing technique.
Target player must face the central space when opening up.
Give&Go: A passes to B's feet, B passes to space ideally with one touch.
Time the runs so you remain onside.
